title: ProficiencyRequest
description: The request body a Body or the eventsink sends on the proficiency request subject (AN-02b): `geldar.<shard>.state.<life_id>.proficiency`, core NATS request/reply. `have_version` is the version the requester already holds; the reply is a ProficiencyState. The body may be empty text, which means 'anything'.

have_version.description: The version the requester already holds. Optional.
